summary: Serializable Action Specs and validated invocation contracts shared by UI, agents, local execution, and cloud execution.
context_hints: Start here when adding or changing an action; UI components and endpoints are adapters, not the contract.
Invocation mode is derived from the originating surface: Canvas is explicit, Asset Preview is implicit.
Read docs/action-spec-system.md before introducing a new editor or generation flow.

key_files.spec.ts: Generic serializable ActionSpec and surface/mode schemas.
key_files.asset-edit.ts: Built-in image/video edit specs, typed invocations, output resolution, and compatibility helpers.
key_files.asset-edit.test.ts: Executable invariants for action discovery, representation, and output kinds.

architecture_notes: Specs contain data only. Executor functions belong to runtime adapters. Successful edit actions create immutable assets with actionInvocation metadata and edit-source lineage.
